readerCopy.body: An unplanned workaround can make an option practical that the old system kept unnecessarily difficult. When Uranus sextiles the North Node, experimentation and forward movement cooperate through a new tool, unusual introduction, revised schedule, different route, or exception. The better method does not have to reinvent the whole plan. Its value is that it removes one stubborn source of friction and gives the next direction more room to be tested.
